news.title: New minor risk - Shareholder dilution
news.body: The company's shareholders have been diluted in the past year. Increase in shares outstanding: 18% This is considered a minor risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS). While dilution might not always result in lower EPS (like if the company is using the capital to fund an EPS accretive acquisition) in a lot cases it does, along with lower dividends per share and less voting power at shareholde

news.title: Eiko LifeSciences Limited announced that it has received INR 74.9375 million in funding from Lenus Finvest Pvt Ltd, V Square Pharmachem Private Limited .
news.body: On February 24, 2026. Eiko LifeSciences Limited announces that it has closed the transaction. It has issued  6,25,000 Equity Shares at a price of INR 55 per equity share for proceeds of INR 34,375,000 and 29,50,000 Warrants at a price of INR 55 per equity share for gross proceeds of INR 40,562,500 for aggregate proceeds of INR 74,937,500.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.88 (vs ₹0.32 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.88 (up from ₹0.32 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹123.0m (up 64% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹12.1m (up 196% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 9.8% (up from 5.4% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 50% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 13% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.body: Eiko LifeSciences Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results on Jan 29, 2026

news.title: Eiko LifeSciences Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 82.5 million in funding from Lenus Finvest Pvt Ltd
news.body: Eiko LifeSciences Limited in its e Board of Directors meeting, announced a private placement of up to 3,300,000 Warrant at a price per warrant of INR 55 for gross proceeds of INR 181,500,000 and  up to 6,75,000 Equity Shares of the company at a price per share of INR 55 for gross proceeds of INR 37,125,000 on preferential basis on December 11, 2025. The Warrants are convertible into one Equity Share of the Face Value of INR 10.
